extracted.intended_audience: nonprofit communications staff, PR directors, and development/marketing teams
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for writing and distributing press releases and PR assets tailored to nonprofit organizations, emphasizing mission, donor relations, beneficiary impact, and crisis communications. Covers story selection, structure, donor-centric content, distribution channels, and a quality checklist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission-driven framing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frame the release around the organization's mission and social impact rather than a product or service; emphasize purpose and outcomes that align with mission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Donor-centric communications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize messaging that speaks to donors' interests and stewardship needs; tailor content to reinforce trust and demonstrate donor impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Volunteer recognition
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include stories or sections that recognize volunteers where appropriate to acknowledge contributions and boost engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community impact emphasis
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlight tangible effects on the community, using specific beneficiaries and measurable outcomes rather than abstract claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partnership amplification
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe partner roles and how collaborations increase impact; use partner quotes and logos with permission to broaden reach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crisis communications focus on trust preservation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In crises, prioritize actions and messages that preserve donor and public trust rather than defensive or organization‑centric messaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact story format
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tell the story of an identifiable beneficiary and include metrics to quantify change (e.g., number of people served, outcomes achieved). Get permissions for personal details and images.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual report release
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When releasing annual reports, summarize key metrics and highlights for media and donors; include accessible visuals and executive commentary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Campaign launch announcement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For campaign launches, state clear, measurable goals and timelines to help media and donors understand purpose and progress benchmarks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partnership announcement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain the partnership's purpose, partners' contributions, expected outcomes, and any joint programs or funding details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award/recognition announcement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Announce awards or recognitions with context on why they matter to mission and how they enable further impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crisis response release (donor accountability)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communicate what happened, how donors are being protected or informed, and steps being taken to address issues; emphasize transparency and remediation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Major gift announcement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Announce large donations with donor permission to recognize support, explain intended use of funds, and show impact; include donor quote if allowed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Headline: mission impact + specific outcome
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Craft a concise headline that pairs the organization's mission with a concrete outcome or result to grab attention and communicate value immediately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lede: who, what, when
rubrics_metrics.description: Lede: Who benefited, what changed, when
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open with the most newsworthy facts—identify the beneficiary, the change or impact, and timing—so editors/readers understand the significance quickly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Body: methodology, partners, quotes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In the body, explain how the outcome was achieved (methods/programs), name partners and funders, and include supporting quotes that contextualize impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Beneficiary quote (with permission)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a quote from a beneficiary to personalize impact, ensuring informed consent and respecting privacy/safety considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Executive quote
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a leadership quote (executive director or program lead) that frames the strategic importance of the work and acknowledges stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Boilerplate content
rubrics_metrics.description: Boilerplate: Mission, year founded, scale, impact
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a standard boilerplate with mission statement, founding year, scale of operations (e.g., geographic reach, people served), and quantifiable impact metrics for context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact info
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact: Communications director or executive director
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List a clear media contact—communications director or executive director—with phone, email, and social handles to facilitate follow-up.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multimedia assets
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide high-quality photos (with release forms), infographics, and other shareable assets to increase pickup and social sharing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific impact per dollar
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Show donors concrete return on giving (e.g., 'Each $25 provides X services'), using verified program metrics to quantify impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Named donor recognition (with permission)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize donors by name only when permission is granted; balance recognition with donor privacy preferences and steward relationships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual giving impact summary
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize how annual donations were used and the outcomes they produced to reinforce stewardship and transparency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Major gift recognition
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publicly acknowledge major gifts per donor agreement and use announcements to illustrate how large gifts enable strategic initiatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foundation grant announcement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe grant purpose, funded activities, expected outcomes, and any required acknowledgment language per funder agreements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency in crisis communications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose facts promptly and honestly in crises; avoid withholding critical information that could undermine trust.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rapid acknowledgment of issues
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Respond quickly to emerging problems with an initial statement of awareness and intent to investigate/action, even if full details are pending.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outline corrective actions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State concrete steps being taken to remedy issues, timelines for action, and who is responsible to reassure stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use independent oversight when appropriate
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When credibility is at stake, commission or reference independent reviews/oversight and communicate findings and recommendations publicly as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dedicated donor communications during crises
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide targeted communications to donors (emails, calls, updates) to maintain stewardship and answer concerns during crises.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public reporting of resolution
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After corrective actions, publicly report outcomes and lessons learned to close the loop and rebuild confidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local press targeting
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pitch local media with a community impact angle—how local people were affected—since local outlets value tangible neighborhood stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sector publication targeting
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Target trade and sector outlets (e.g., philanthropy-focused publications) for sector-specific announcements and donor/funder audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include donor newsletter
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Feature releases or summaries in donor newsletters to ensure supporters receive news directly and feel informed about impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Volunteer communication channels
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Share appropriate news through volunteer mailing lists and platforms to acknowledge their role and encourage advocacy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social media with shareable assets
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare social posts and ready-to-share assets (images, short captions, hashtags) to amplify reach and encourage supporter sharing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wire syndication for SEO
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use wire services to syndicate releases for broader discoverability and SEO benefits, while tailoring pitches for targeted outlets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission-aligned story (quality check)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As a quality criterion, ensure every press release aligns with and advances the organization's mission; discard or reframe stories that feel tangential.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific beneficiary impact (quality check)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quality releases include specific, verifiable beneficiary outcomes rather than vague or qualitative claims; support with numbers where possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear methodology (quality check)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain how impact was measured or achieved (program steps, evaluation methods) so claims are credible and reproducible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multimedia demonstrates impact (quality check)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include visuals that clearly illustrate impact—photos, infographics, or charts—to make the story more compelling and shareable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparent reporting (quality check)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report successes and setbacks openly; provide sources, data, and follow-ups that support claims and build long-term credibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appropriate donor recognition (quality check)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize donors when appropriate and permitted, balancing public acknowledgment with donor privacy and stewardship best practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crisis trust preservation (quality check)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate crisis-related releases on whether they preserve or rebuild stakeholder trust through transparency, action, and accountability.
